title: 云原生观测与 AI Agent 基础设施：从高精度指标到自主工程系统
english: Recent developments highlight a convergence between cloud-native operations and AI engineering. Kubernetes v1.37 makes native histogram support Beta and enables it by default, providing higher-resolution, lower-cardinality metrics while reducing telemetry storage and scraping overhead. CNCF reports that distributed AI training requires more than GPU provisioning and cluster creation, with platform bottlenecks emerging once training spans multiple nodes. OpenAI also describes systems where GPT-6 Astra writes communications, changes software, monitors production systems, and helps Devin test its own work. Together, these examples point toward infrastructure that must support accurate observability, distributed AI workloads, and agents capable of operating across software lifecycles. For senior engineers, reliability controls, verification, and production monitoring remain central as agent autonomy increases.
chinese: 近期信息显示，云原生运维与 AI 工程基础设施正在更加紧密地结合。Kubernetes v1.37 中，原生直方图支持进入 Beta 阶段并默认启用，可提供更高分辨率、更低基数的指标，同时降低遥测存储和抓取开销。CNCF 指出，分布式 AI 训练对平台的要求不止是提供 GPU 和创建集群；当训练跨越多个节点后，基础设施瓶颈会更加明显。OpenAI 的案例则展示了 GPT-6 Astra 在通信编写、软件修改、生产系统监控和软件测试中的应用。对资深运维开发而言，未来重点包括高质量可观测性、分布式训练平台、Agent 的验证机制，以及在更高自主性下维持生产可靠性。
why_it_matters: 原生直方图可改善 Kubernetes 指标的延迟与持续时间观测，为 AIOps 和生产诊断提供更精细的数据基础。分布式 AI 训练要求平台团队处理跨节点基础设施问题，推动云原生平台向 AI-ready 方向演进。能够修改软件、监控生产系统并测试自身工作的 Agent，会扩大 Agent Infra 的运维边界，也提高了权限控制、验证、审计和可靠性工程的重要性。对职业发展而言，掌握 Kubernetes 可观测性、分布式 AI 基础设施和 Agent 运行治理，将直接连接云原生运维与 AI 平台工程。
interview_expression: I see observability and verification as prerequisites for increasing agent autonomy in production. Native histograms can improve metric accuracy, while distributed AI training requires platform engineering beyond simply provisioning GPUs.

sources.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Native Histograms Graduates to Beta
sources.summary:
I'm excited to announce that native histogram support for Kubernetes metrics is graduating to Beta and is enabled by default in Kubernetes v1.37!

Native histograms (previously introduced as Alpha in Kubernetes v1.36 under KEP-5808) bring high-resolution, low-cardinality observability to Kubernetes metrics. By adopting Prometheus Native Histograms, Kubernetes components now expose latency and duration metrics with far greater accuracy while significantly reducing telemetry storage and scraping overhead.
